```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(hunspell)
```

## data
```{r}
data <- read.csv("") ## add your data here. it should contain at least: 1. word column, 2. corresponding familiarity ratings
```

## criterium A
```{r}
## words with low familiarity (< 3.5) are excluded because other ratings (f.e. valence) are not useful if the participant does not know the meaning of a word.
data <- data %>% mutate(criterium_A = familiarity_german >= 3.5) 
```

## criterium B
```{r}
## words that are not found in the dictionary are also excluded
data$criterium_B <- hunspell_check(as.character(data$Word), dict = "de_DE_frami") # change to dict = "en_US" for english words!
```
